Sophie: @Raj quick sync on Orbit partner co-marketing — we need to lock webinar date, lead routing, and benchmark narrative. :wave:
Raj: Available to run this — what's the target audience? enterprise infra + platform teams?
Ian: Yep that's the audience. We should highlight latency/cost savings vs native endpoints in the benchmark.
Maya: I'll need 1 hero slide and a 2-page one-pager. Do we have final numbers?
Sophie: We have preliminary bench: 3x lower token cost with batching + 30% lower p99 latency on tail workloads. Need final QA from eng.
Raj: I'll coordinate partner portal assets. Partner can offer a case study and an intro to their head of platform for the webinar.
Ian: Routing: propose partner leads go to partner SDR queue; joint leads go to shared triage. Also add UTMs so both sides can attribute.
Sophie: Agreed. @Raj can you confirm partner's CRM webhook and preferred contact email?
Raj: Partner webhook: orbit-webhook@orbit.example.com. They want "partner_origin=orbit" in the payload.
Sophie: For tracking use this UTM template:
```
utm_source=orbit_partner&utm_medium=co-marketing&utm_campaign=orbit_launch_2026&utm_content=webinar
```
Maya: CTA: "Try Redwood with Orbit integration" -> /signup?prefill=orbit_integration
Ian: Draft lead routing (pseudo):
```
if lead.company_domain in partner_domain_list -> assign: partner_sdr_queue
elif lead.form_value == "webinar_demo_interest" -> assign: internal_product_ae
else -> assign: marketing_nurture
```
Sophie: Need slides by Mon 2026-04-06 for rehearsal on Wed. Can eng sign-off by Fri 2026-04-03?
Raj: I'll confirm partner speakers by EOD tomorrow and get legal review on messaging.
Maya: Shared initial slide mock: https://drive.example.com/s/slide-draft — feedback welcome.
Ian: I'll own registration page + followup cadence. Plan: registration -> on-demand recording -> 3-email nurture with benchmark one-pager.
Sophie: One-pager should be co-branded and include abbreviated benchmark callouts: "3x lower cost for high-throughput LLM inference".
Raj: Partner legal review contact: partners-legal@orbit.example.com — send final copy there.
Sophie: Ops update: calendar invite created.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Redwood x Orbit — Integration Launch Webinar" 2026-04-08 16:00 UTC. Invite: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123
Sophie: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after eng sign-off. :tada:
